summary.status: Production immutable invalidation blocks qualified on the unchanged four-CU desktop RTL.
summary.change: Predecode literal immutable uint16 page lists into fixed eight/four-cell blocks and scalar remainders. Portable unsigned increments preserve every multiplicity and modulo-2^32 result; dynamic, partial, shadowed or unknown uses retain the generic helper.
summary.profile_scope: Rebuild only the commit caller using the existing compatible CFG profile and original source basename, with both profile mismatch warnings treated as errors. New tiny helper uses O2 without PGO. All remaining archive objects are byte-identical to the selected shared-dispatch baseline.
summary.timing_scope: Final packaged libraries, three balanced fresh processes per variant and workload, Latin-square order with equal mean position. Fixed current Mesa64 trace and identical native inputs. No competing qualification jobs during timing. All RAM, counters and strict replay outputs match.
limitations: Full640 functional guest and strict replay overlap; their elapsed times do not establish a paired whole-desktop speedup.
Published gains use final packaged libraries, not the larger preliminary direct-object screen gains.
Original idle MHz, old 39kHz desktop recording and active rendering measure different logic activity; do not extrapolate one rate to another workload.
Installed/default QEMU is unchanged; qualification uses an explicitly linked private executable.
Private validators reuse older descriptive scope strings; archive hashes, current inputs and explicit exact-output checks identify this host-only change.

production_equivalence.scope: Apply the exact production post-split transform to the qualified unchanged header and legacy commit caller. Both outputs are byte-identical to the already screened compiled candidate; the rest of the splitter is unchanged.

rejected_variable_run_helper.scope: Selected main PGO baseline. Candidate retains every selected archive member except commit chunks, rebuilt using the exact same CFG profile under the same source basename. A new small run helper uses O2; original generic helper remains byte-identical in the archive. No whole-model generation/retraining. Require compiler profile compatibility plus exact RAM, clocks, holds, commits and DMA.

host_benchmark.scope: Final packaged archives: pre-dispatch baseline, selected shared-dispatch main, and immutable-block candidate. Every RAM byte and all counters/trace callbacks identical.
